description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the&nbsp;<strong>FinTech</strong> connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers <strong>better interest rates</strong> and banks a <strong>diversified form of refinancing</strong>. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from&nbsp;<strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>The Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) department is responsible for preventing, detecting, and combating financial crime, thereby ensuring that Raisin bank is not misused for illegal purposes such as money laundering, terrorist financing, or fraud.</p> <p>Within this department, the AFC Advisory team plays a central role by developing and monitoring internal policies, control mechanisms, and training programs. We ensure robust money laundering compliance across the entire organization, acting as a collaborative hub of senior expertise where we balance regulatory obligations with sustainable business growth.</p> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstList"> <li class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated"><strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="4">Project Leadership:</span></strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="5">&nbsp;Own the planning, implementation, and documentation of bank-wide and client-related AFC projects.</span></li> <li class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated"><strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="6">Framework Optimization:</span></strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="7">&nbsp;Drive the strategic development of our AML framework, including the enhancement of IT systems and automated controls.</span></li> <li class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated"><strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="8">Process &amp; Training:</span></strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="17">&nbsp;Provide expert guidance on regulatory requirements and conduct training sessions to foster compliance awareness throughout the bank.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <ul class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstList"> <li class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated"><strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="19">Experience:</span></strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="20">&nbsp;Several years of professional experience in Anti-Financial Crime within a banking or consulting environment.</span></li> <li class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated"><strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="21">Regulatory Knowledge:</span></strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="22">&nbsp;In-depth understanding of German and EU regulatory frameworks including GwG, BaFin AuA, AML-VO, EBA Guidelines, FATF recommendations, and KWG.</span></li> <li class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated"><strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="23">Domain Expertise:</span></strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="24">&nbsp;Proven track record in KYC, customer identification, and the creation of accurate risk analyses and customer risk ratings.</span></li> <li class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated"><strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="25">Analytical Rigor:</span></strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="26">&nbsp;Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulations into conceptual solutions, with an openness to leveraging technological innovations.</span></li> <li class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated"><strong><span class="appsElementsGenerativeaiAstAnimated" data-ast-node-id="27">Communication &amp; title: Enterprise Account Executive - DACH
description: <div>At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. <br><br>When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div style="text-align: center;"> <p><strong>Enterprise Account Executive - DACH</strong></p> </div> <p><strong>Why We Have This Role</strong></p> <div> <div>Qualtrics is on the lookout for a proactive, collaborative seller that can help us lead and own the strategy for selling Experience Management (XM) SaaS within the largest accounts in the DACH market. We’re helping the world’s leading companies improve experiences. Our solutions allow our clients to have a 360° view of the entire experience enabling them to uncover what matters most to clients and employees with the ability to take action in real time. In the Enterprise Sales role, you will be working with Major Accounts with an overarching objective to drive company revenue growth through net new customer acquisition and expansion in our current customer base. This person will work collaboratively to meet sales goals and deliver the highest standard of integrity, quality, and customer service to our clients.</div> </div> <p><strong>How You’ll Find Success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relationship Building: Master stakeholder mapping to cultivate relationships with multiple contacts within an account, ensuring lasting partnerships.</li> <li>Negotiation Skills: Navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take.</li> <li>Multi-Selling Approach: Drive engagement with various business stakeholders in parallel to create multifaceted selling opportunities.</li> <li>Empathetic Competitiveness: While being competitive, possess the ability to empathise and understand others’ perspectives.</li> <li>Entrepreneurial Mindset: Take initiative to grasp the expected outcomes and context, working independently to drive results.</li> <li>Effective Communication: Influence effectively at all levels, creating trust and collaboration within the team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How You’ll Grow</strong></p> <ul> <li>By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a revolutionary team committed to shaping groundbreaking experiences.</li> <li>You will help us expand the XM category beyond where it is today with more advanced use cases &amp; pioneering advancements in AI.</li> <li>Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.</li> <li>As a member of our global sales organisation, you will take ownership of a dedicated territory and develop robust strategies designed to drive demand and revenue.</li> <li>We foster an environment that encourages big-picture thinking, innovation, and creativity, enabling you to build relationships with multiple decision-makers and articulate the unique value proposition of Qualtrics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Things You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Focus on acquiring new business and sell the Qualtrics Platform to key accounts.</li> <li>Develop comprehensive account plans, from power maps to demand generation and closing strategies.</li> <li>Manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies.</li> <li>Strategising internally with SDRs (sales development representatives), solutions consultants, partners etc to create demand and drive senior engagement in accounts.</li> <li>Gain a thorough understanding of prospects' business issues and industry challenges to craft tailored solutions.</li> <li>Build compelling business cases that demonstrate clear ROI and value for clients.</li> <li>Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics' offerings and the competitive landscape to provide win-based proposals and pricing strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For On Your Resume</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience selling SaaS solutions, and experience in discussing strategic business issues at Director and C level in Large Enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Significant demonstrated success in driving and navigating C-level engagement &amp; connections at the highest level.</li> <li>Significant experience in leading, planning and closing 7 figure deals.</li> <li>Significant experience in owning the full commercial capacity of Strategic Accounts.</li> <li>Strong track record in achieving and exceeding sales quotas.</li> <li>Ability to be creative in driving engagement with new contacts within an account.</li> <li>Fluency in German and English.</li> <li>You are passionate about educating potential clients on solutions relevant to their situation and helping them understand how the software can drive a return on investment for them.</li> <li>You can leverage your network in the market to generate interest in Qualtrics solutions.</li> <li>You have a desire to manage a territory like running your own consultancy.</li> <li>You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.</li> <li>You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business.</li> <li>You partner well with internal teams and bring together internal resources that enable successful closure of deals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Should Know About This Team</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Qualtrics global sales team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on experiences. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that's a solution you can get behind.</li> <li>As an Enterprise Sales professional, you will focus on new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling. Our most successful sales employees have a track record of exceeding quotas, acting as trusted advisors to clients and being passionate teammates.</li> <li>The Qualtrics platform is versatile, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing.</li> <li>Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation.</li> <li>We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Qualtrics Experience Program - A bonus each year for an experience of your choosing</li> <li>Worldwide and diverse community that enjoys helping each other</li> <li>At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team</li> </ul> <div><strong>The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model</strong>: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:<a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/fmla">Family &amp; Medical Leave Act</a>, <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/poster">Equal Opportunity Employment</a>, <a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/employee-polygraph-protection-act">Employee Polygraph Protection Act</a></em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du interessierst dich für Themen des E-Government und der Digitalisierung von Verwaltungsdienstleistungen? 
Du willst daran mitwirken, die digitale Transformation voranzubringen? Du hast Lust, Bürger:innen und Unternehmen mit intelligenten Online-Angeboten den Weg zum Amt zu ersparen? Du möchtest Teil eines netten Teams sein, das unsere Kunden aus dem Public Sector auf ihrem Weg in die Digitalisierung unterstützt? Dann bist du bei unseren Mainzer Consultants bestens aufgehoben. Als Werkstudent:in Consulting (all genders) unterstützt du uns an vorderster Front. Praxis Pur!   

Bitte beachte, dass dies eine befristete Position, ausgelegt auf 12 Monate, ist.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du erhältst Einblicke in Projekte zur Unterstützung der Öffentlichen Hand bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Leistungen
  • Bring dich bei der Konzeption moderner, nutzerzentrierter Online-Services für die Verwaltung ein
  • Du analysierst Verwaltungsprozesse und identifizierst Potentiale für bessere technische Unterstützung
  • Beratung zur Weiterentwicklung von Organisations- und Projektstrukturen in der Verwaltung
  • Trete in den Austausch mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen zu fachlichen und technischen Herausforderungen


Das bringst du mit

  • Du befindest dich in einem Masterstudium
  • Du bringst erste Erfahrungen mit Verwaltungsprozessen oder mit der Gestaltung guter Online-Services mit und bist bereit, dich in den jeweils anderen Bereich einzuarbeiten
  • Das Interesse den Prozess der Verwaltungsmodernisierung mitzugestalten und dabei über den Tellerrand hinaus zu denken
  • Leidenschaft für das Thema E-Government und Freude am engen Austausch mit Kolleg:innen und Kunden
  • Neugierde, Leistungsbereitschaft und Spaß an der Arbeit mit interdisziplinären Projektteams
  • Zeit und Lust, das Consulting-Team wöchentlich 16-20h zu unterstützen
  • Du bringst Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Level in Wort und Schrift mit


Das bieten wir dir

  • Befristete Position auf 12 Monate: Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, wertvolle Erfahrungen in einem spannenden und dynamischen Umfeld zu sammeln
  • Because we care: Deine Work-Life-Balance liegt uns am Herzen. Aus diesem Grund sichern wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Workation im EU-Ausland zu!
  • Work with us: Wir arbeiten mobil zusammen - ob auf dem Campus oder im Office bei uns, du entscheidest, von wo du arbeiten möchtest
  • Werkstudent+:  Wir bieten dir spannende und gesellschaftsrelevante Projekte zudem jede Menge Gestaltungsfreiraum für deine Karriere. Mit unserem Stipendium unterstützen wir dich finanziell und du profitierst von unseren vielfältigen Vernetzungsangeboten.
  • Learn with us: Dein persönliches Wachstum liegt uns am Herzen. Von deinen Kolleg:innen bekommst du stets frischen Wind und neues Wissen. In Trainings unserer Academy hast du die Möglichkeit, dich beruflich und persönlich fortzubilden. Work with us and grow with us!
  • Grow with us: Lerne unsere Learning Sessions & Nutshells kennen, die dir einen Blick über den Tellerrand für deine individuelle und berufliche Weiterentwicklung ermöglichen.
  • Start with us: Dein Einstieg ist vom ersten Moment an organisiert! Mit unserer virtuellen Welcome Week kommst du bei ]init[ richtig gut an. Eine enge Begleitung durch Patenschaften gehört bei uns zu einem gelungenen Start dazu.


Werde Teil des Teams

Du arbeitest eng mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin sowie AI Engineers und Product-Expert:innen zusammen und bewegst dich täglich zwischen Strategie, Produktentwicklung und AI. AI begeistert dich wirklich: Du musst keine Software entwickeln können - aber du beschäftigst dich freiwillig mit AI. Vielleicht nutzt du Claude oder ChatGPT täglich, hast schon mit Lovable oder Cursor experimentiert oder fragst dich regelmäßig: "Das müsste man doch automatisieren können." Genau diese Neugier suchen wir. Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte sauber und nutzt PowerPoint und Excel sicher genug, um überzeugende Management-Präsentationen und Business Cases aufzubereiten. Mindset: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt erklärt. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, denkst unternehmerisch und willst Lösungen entwickeln statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst und präsentierst in verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst natürlich über eine gesunde Portion Humor. Rahmenbedingungen: Du hast 16 - 20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters Kapazität bei uns vor Ort im Münchner Headquarter tätig zu sein. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit flexibel bis Vollzeit möglich. title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Developer Enablement (m/f/d)
description: Quantum Systems has scaled rapidly from 300 to over 1,700 people, and our engineering practices need to evolve with us. As part of the Software Factory team within our Core Domain, your mission is to accelerate developer velocity, eliminate friction, and upgrade system quality across the entire organization. You won’t just maintain infrastructure; you will actively shape our engineering culture. You will design, build, and champion the state-of-the-art development tooling and CI infrastructure that powers our large, polyglot environment. From defining pragmatic engineering processes to tracking our success with metrics such as DORA, you will ensure our engineering teams can move faster and safer. What is your Day to Day Mission: Drive Technical & Process Evolution: Mentor and guide software teams toward modern engineering practices (e.g., modern monorepos, automated testing, trunk-based development). You will gain authentic buy-in by demonstrating the "why" rather than forcing compliance. Bridge the Gap: Meet teams where they are currently. By truly understanding their pain points and listening to resistance, you will build a roadmap to gently but firmly guide them toward efficiency. Eliminate Friction: Identify opportunities to simplify processes and streamline workflows. Your ultimate goal is creating a faster, smoother Developer Experience (DevEx). Cultivate a Growth Mindset: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and iterative learning (Kaizen). You will help the team turn operational mistakes into blameless learning opportunities. Evolve the Build & CI Ecosystem: Continuously optimize our large-scale build and CI/CD environments. You will ensure fast, reliable, and reproducible feedback loops for developers. Shape the Future Base OS: Collaborate with embedded and infrastructure teams on our transition toward a managed, image-based Base OS for high-performance compute targets. What you bring to the team: The Transformation Toolkit Patience & Pragmatism: You understand that cultural shifts don't happen overnight, allowing you to celebrate small wins, build momentum, and remain non-dogmatic under pressure. High EQ & Influence: An empathetic communicator with the exceptional skills required to address fears of change and motivate teams through inspiration rather than mandate. Tech Credibility: A strong software engineering background that allows you to speak the team’s language, understand constraints, and earn their technical respect. Technical Skills (Required) Build System Expertise: Strong experience managing, scaling, or architecting build systems for large, polyglot codebases. You should be comfortable with advanced build orchestration. CI/CD & DevTools Automation: Deep practical knowledge of building and operating robust CI/CD pipelines and developer enablement tools at scale. Process & Velocity Focus: Experience defining and rolling out clean engineering standards (Definition of Done, linting) and a passion for measuring developer experience using data (like DORA metrics). Linux Fundamentals: Solid grasp of Linux-based systems, networking, and deployment automation. Preferred Skills (Nice to Have) Bazel Expertise: Deep experience with Bazel is a massive plus and will give you a major head start. Image-Based Provisioning: Experience with modern OS compilation, immutable infrastructure, or image-based provisioning for high-performance compute/embedded targets (e.g., Yocto, Nix/NixOS, systemd-mkosi, or Nvidia Jetpack). Cloud & IaC Foundations: Familiarity with cloud-native systems and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to interface effectively with our dedicated cloud teams. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • Eliminate Friction: Identify opportunities to simplify processes and streamline workflows. Your ultimate goal is creating a faster, smoother Developer Experience (DevEx).

  • Cultivate a Growth Mindset: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and iterative learning (Kaizen). You will help the team turn operational mistakes into blameless learning opportunities.

  • Evolve the Build & CI Ecosystem: Continuously optimize our large-scale build and CI/CD environments. You will ensure fast, reliable, and reproducible feedback loops for developers.

  • Shape the Future Base OS: Collaborate with embedded and infrastructure teams on our transition toward a managed, image-based Base OS for high-performance compute targets.



What you bring to the team:

The Transformation Toolkit

  • Patience & Pragmatism: You understand that cultural shifts don't happen overnight, allowing you to celebrate small wins, build momentum, and remain non-dogmatic under pressure.

  • High EQ & Influence: An empathetic communicator with the exceptional skills required to address fears of change and motivate teams through inspiration rather than mandate.

  • Tech Credibility: A strong software engineering background that allows you to speak the team’s language, understand constraints, and earn their technical respect.

Technical Skills (Required)

  • CI/CD & DevTools Automation: Deep practical knowledge of building and operating robust CI/CD pipelines and developer enablement tools at scale.

  • Process & Velocity Focus: Experience defining and rolling out clean engineering standards (Definition of Done, linting) and a passion for measuring developer experience using data (like DORA metrics).

  • Linux Fundamentals: Solid grasp of Linux-based systems, networking, and deployment automation.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Bazel Expertise: Deep experience with Bazel is a massive plus and will give you a major head start.

  • Image-Based Provisioning: Experience with modern OS compilation, immutable infrastructure, or image-based provisioning for high-performance compute/embedded targets (e.g., Yocto, Nix/NixOS, systemd-mkosi, or Nvidia Jetpack).

  • Cloud & IaC Foundations: Familiarity with cloud-native systems and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to interface effectively with our dedicated cloud teams.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

description: <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>About commercetools</strong></span></h4> <p>Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.</p> <p>Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.</p> <p>At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Your Impact</strong></span></h4> <p>As our <strong>Senior Strategic Account Executive</strong>, you will be responsible for securing and expanding the largest and most transformative enterprise clients of commercetools in our core verticals including retail and B2B. You will lead C-suite engagements, navigate multi-year digital transformation initiatives, and close complex, multi-million dollar platform deals that define commercetools’ market leadership. This is a high impact, quota carrying role reserved for top-performing enterprise salespeople with the DNA for large scale clients, ensuring we delight our customers, retain and grow our business together with them.</p> <p>You are viewed as a market influencer, strategic advisor, and deal orchestrator - responsible not only for revenue generation, but for accelerating commercetools dominance in the enterprise commerce platform category.&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Own and grow a portfolio of the highest-value retail and CPG strategic enterprise accounts.&nbsp;</li> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact for these accounts from an sales and account management&nbsp; perspective, and in tight collaboration with our CS (customer success) team and orchestrating the executive relationships as well as all of commercetools in the pursuit of maximizing the value of the relationship with these clients for both parties</li> <li>Lead complex, multi-threaded sales cycles involving CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CMOs, CFOs, and their teams.</li> <li>Solution Differentiation &amp; Technical Collaboration: Articulate commercetools' capabilities and differentiation clearly. Collaborate with solutions consultants to engage technical teams effectively.</li> <li>Value: Partner tightly with the value engineering team to ensure we are focused on outcomes for our customers, and drive our top line growth with cross and up-sell campaigns.</li> <li>Organizational sales orchestration: Manage the complex sales process inclusive of MEDDPICC, notably the relationships at these clients (Champions, EBs, influencers and others)</li> <li>Partnering: Collaborate with our ISVs and SIs to ensure the successes noted above.</li> <li>Develop tailored account plans for each client and manage the cadence for continuous execution.</li> <li>Orchestrate internal and external resources including alliances, professional services, product leadership, and GSI’s to craft enterprise transformation roadmaps.&nbsp;</li> <li>Influence digital strategy at the board and executive level; position commercetools as an innovation partner rather than a vendor.&nbsp;</li> <li>Close multi-year, multi-solution platform agreements that drive long-term value realization across multiple lines of business, regions, and brands. Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas.</li> <li>Track, analyze, and report on key account metrics, such as revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and project delivery.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></span></h4> <p>You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.</p> <p>Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.</p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in Enterprise SaaS&nbsp;</li> <li>Fluent in German&nbsp;</li> <li>Elite-level enterprise sales experience, specializing in the highest-stakes, most complex global accounts.</li> <li>Career history includes multiple instances of securing foundational, 7-figure ACV deals in net-new accounts.</li> <li>Enterprise SaaS sales experience with a proven track record of annual quota achievement. Prefer commerce background or at minimum, mission critical applications software.</li> <li>Demonstrated success closing multi-million dollar, multi-year contracts with large scale organizations.&nbsp;</li> <li>Exceptional executive presence with experience influencing C-suite stakeholders and board-level decision making.</li> <li>Strategic mindset with the ability to design and executive large-scale transformation deals.</li> <li>Recognized top-performer status in previous roles (Presidents Club/Top 5%/ Chairman’s Club, etc).&nbsp;</li> <li>AI Aptitude<strong>:</strong> A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Our Benefits</strong></span></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our benefits,<a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits"> visit this page.</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></span></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices,<a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg"> visit this page</a>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Damit im Hintergrund alles reibungslos funktioniert, müssen Zahlungen verarbeitet, Abonnements verwaltet, Business-Partner abgerechnet, Betrugsversuche erkannt und aussagekräftige Reports erstellt werden. Wir suchen jemanden, der komplexe Prozesse versteht, gerne analytisch arbeitet und Spaß daran hat, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklern intelligente Lösungen zu entwickeln. Wenn Du Geschäftsprozesse lieber neu denkst als verwaltest und Daten für Dich mehr sind als Tabellen, solltest Du weiterlesen. Deine Mission Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Technology und Data. Gemeinsam mit Finance, Business Intelligence, Engineering und unseren Softwarepartnern entwickelst Du unsere Business-Systeme rund um Payments und Revenue kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei sorgst Du dafür, dass Prozesse einfacher, intelligenter und stärker automatisiert werden und wir jederzeit auf verlässliche Daten und Kennzahlen vertrauen können. Business und Technologie verbinden Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, entwickelst daraus Lösungskonzepte und stimmst deren Umsetzung mit unseren Engineering-Teams und externen Softwarepartnern ab. Daten intelligent nutzen Gemeinsam mit unserem BI-Team entwickelst Du KPIs, Reports und Dashboards. Wenn Du Freude daran hast, erstellst Du Analysen auch selbst – beispielsweise mit BigQuery oder Tableau. Automatisierung vorantreiben Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe, entwickelst Automatisierungskonzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung. Fraud bekämpfen Du entwickelst unsere Prozesse zur Fraud Detection & Prevention kontinuierlich weiter und nutzt Datenanalysen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen. Warum waipu.tv? Du entwickelst Systeme und Prozesse, die täglich Millionen von Transaktionen unterstützen und direkten Einfluss auf unser Geschäft haben. Du arbeitest eng mit einem erfahrenen Business-Intelligence-Team, unseren Engineering-Teams und den Fachbereichen zusammen und kannst Ideen schnell in die Praxis umsetzen. raw.title: AI Marketing Operator
raw.description:
Remote (European time zones) · Full-time · Start: Q4 2026 · Quarterly in-person team events

Apply with: CV + LinkedIn profile

We are not looking for a marketing person who understands AI. We are looking for an AI person with a marketing background.

About MultiBase

MultiBase is a Business Intelligence and Analytics consultancy with 35 years of experience guiding mid-sized companies in the DACH region to turn data into profit. MultiBase's 1,500+ projects. 400+ clients. Serving the DACH region since 1991. Our audience: CFOs and Heads of Controlling.

We are at an inflection point: shifting from traditional BI consulting to an AI-accelerated, IP-driven business built on our proprietary DECIDE framework. AI is not a tool here. It is an operational layer. Our founder creates the content and sets the strategy. Our AI agents write the copy. What is missing is the person who makes the whole machine run.

Tasks

The Role

You are the production and distribution engine of our marketing. Content direction and strategy come from the founder. Your job is to make that machine run at scale - and improve it as you go.

You report to the management. You will not be managed day-to-day, but you have a clear escalation path when a decision needs to be made. You interpret a brief correctly the first time, deliver without back-and-forth, and raise problems before anyone asks.

Concretely:

  • Own and run the marketing digital workforce: build, deploy, monitor, and improve AI agents and automated workflows across marketing and business development
  • Own the content calendar and the full publishing operation: YouTube uploads (titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, thumbnail briefings), LinkedIn scheduling, newsletter dispatch via our CRM. Zero missed publish dates
  • Build automations that remove manual steps from our workflows (agentic platforms, CRM automations, API integrations), so the human time required in marketing goes down, not up
  • Coordinate video production timelines with our editor and manage asset quality against the brief
  • Brief and steer an external paid-ads specialist: audience and ICP input, tracking setup (pixel, UTM), performance review against lead quality, not vanity metrics
  • Build and maintain an automated weekly performance report (YouTube, LinkedIn, newsletter, CRM) that management can read in 5 minutes
  • Produce and format supporting marketing assets: presentations, papers, website updates

Requirements

Who You Are

  • An executor, not a talker. Your value is that things ship, reliably, without anyone chasing you
  • Systematic by nature: you build checklists, SOPs, and processes because chaos offends you
  • AI-native: you work with AI agents as colleagues, not as occasional tools. You brief them, challenge their output, and push back when they are wrong
  • Self-correcting: when something breaks, you fix it fast and adjust the process so it does not break again
  • You care about outcomes (qualified leads, published assets, hours saved), not titles

Must-Have

  • AI-native, proven: daily, hands-on proficiency with at least one major agentic platform (n8n, Make, Claude Code / Cowork, OpenClaw, Hermes, or any comparable orchestration and automation platform). You have built and run agents and automated workflows, not just written prompts. This is the single most important requirement
  • 2+ years in a B2B marketing environment (agency or in-house), in a small team where you owned outcomes end-to-end
  • Content operations experience: you have run a content calendar and multi-channel publishing workflow (video, social, email) for a real brand
  • Marketing automation: you build workflows yourself, without engineering support
  • Paid ads literacy: enough to brief a specialist, review campaign performance, and catch obvious errors in targeting and tracking. You do not need to be the specialist
  • Business-level English required. German at any level is a meaningful advantage for this role
  • Self-directed: you do not need daily management

Nice to Have (Not Required)

  • German: a strong plus for reviewing and quality-checking DACH content
  • GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM experience
  • Short-form video production (Reels, Shorts), thumbnail creation, basic editing
  • Experience using LLM APIs (Claude, GPT) for marketing automation
  • B2B content marketing experience for mid-market DACH companies

This Role Is Not For You If...

  • Your primary identity is "I'm a creative" or "I'm a strategist". Strategy and creative direction are owned by the founder
  • You use AI "sometimes" and cannot describe specific workflows you have built
  • You need a detailed brief and daily check-ins for every task
  • You cannot name concrete results from your previous marketing work
  • You have only worked in large marketing departments with clear lane separation
  • You accept AI output without questioning whether it is right

What Success Looks Like

After 3 months:

  • You own the content calendar completely: zero missed publish dates
  • Management spends zero time on content logistics: they create, the machine handles the rest
  • At least two automations are live that removed manual steps from the current workflow
  • At least one paid campaign is running with clean tracking and a clear performance report
  • The automated weekly marketing report exists and takes 5 minutes to read

After 6 months:

  • A consistent flow of warm, qualified leads comes from content and paid channels, without management having to run marketing operations
  • The marketing digital workforce is operational, documented, and measurably reducing manual work every month

Benefits

What You Get

  • Direct access to management: zero layers, zero bureaucracy
  • A real digital-workforce mandate: you build and own the marketing machine
  • Full AI tool budget
  • Remote-first, core hours 10:00-16:00 CET
  • Quarterly in-person team weeks in Paphos, Cyprus
  • You will be joining a team of 17, working closely with our content and video production team
  • Compensation: competitive, based on experience and location, plus performance-based bonus

How to Apply

Send us your CV and your LinkedIn profile. Nothing else. No cover letter.

Optional: in three sentences, tell us what you have built with AI and what it did. This is not required - but it is the fastest way to stand out.

MultiBase GmbH is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants are evaluated regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil, jedoch kein Muss Shopify Erfahrung oder schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du kennst dich mit Produkten, Collections, Varianten und Metaobjekten aus oder lernst dich schnell dort ein Detailgenauigkeit: Kleine Unstimmigkeiten fallen dir sofort auf, und du gehst ihnen konsequent auf den Grund Copywriting Gespür: Du schreibst Bulletpoints und Texte athletisch, direkt und ohne Marketing-Floskeln Strukturiertes Arbeiten: Du organisierst deine Aufgaben sauber und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick Kundenperspektive: Du verstehst, wie Kund*innen den Shop erleben, und denkst Fixes von dort aus Praxiserfahrung: Praktische Berührungspunkte mit E-Commerce oder Shop-Systemen, unabhängig davon, wie viel Berufserfahrung du mitbringst Nice to have: Erste Berührung mit Compliance-Themen (Widerrufsrecht, Gewährleistung, PAngV) Grundkenntnisse SEO (On-Page, Überschriftenstruktur) Grundverständnis HTML/CSS, um Textblöcke und Sections selbst anzupassen Bezug zur Calisthenics-Szene ist von Vorteil Benefits Top Arbeits-Equipment: Du bekommst ein MacBook für deine Arbeit, das dir hilft, produktiv und effizient zu arbeiten. Fitness inklusive: Wir trainieren regelmäßig gemeinsam nach der Arbeit, entweder in unserem Fitnessraum im Office-Gebäude oder draußen. Steuerfreier Sachbezug: Du erhältst eine Wellpass Mitgliedschaft, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung oder eine Tankkarte als steuerfreien Sachbezug. Teamevents & Networking: Neben tollen Teamevents bekommst du auch die Gelegenheit, mit internationalen Calisthenics-Athleten in Kontakt zu treten und von ihnen zu lernen. Erlebe die FIBO: Mit deinem 4-Tage-Ticket für die FIBO - der größten Fitnessmesse der Welt - hast du Zugang zur Fitness-Welt in Köln. Komfort bei der Arbeit: Jeder Arbeitsplatz ist mit einem höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch ausgestattet, damit du zwischen Sitzen und Stehen wechseln kannst, um produktiv und gesund zu bleiben. Kaffee- & Wasser-Flat: Genieße erstklassigen Kaffee aus unserer hochwertigen Kaffeemaschine und stets frisches Wasser aus unserer Wasserfilteranlage. Exklusive Rabatte: Profitiere von Mitarbeiterrabatten auf unsere Equipments und Kleidung für dein Training. Persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Office: Wir setzen auf echte Begegnungen im Büro in Münster statt endloser Online-Calls. Unser Ziel: Ein Office, in dem man sich wohlfühlt und in das man gerne kommt Hundefreundlicher Arbeitsplatz: Nach Absprache kannst du deinen Hund mit ins Büro nehmen. E-Auto-Ladestation am Campus: Du kannst dein E-Auto bequem direkt am Office laden. Möchtest du in einem familiären Umfeld an spannenden Projekten mitarbeiten? description: <h1>Senior Director of Product, Engagement (f/m/x)</h1> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>HelloFresh has spent nearly fifteen years perfecting the home cooking experience, and is now extending that expertise beyond the weekly meal kit to become a daily kitchen companion for any home cook — from the first scroll of inspiration to the moment you plate your meal. You will lead <strong>the Engagement tribe</strong>, which focuses on deepening customers' relationships with our brands, is the driving force behind this shift. It's a highly visible mandate with sustained attention from senior leadership.</p> <p>The tribe's work spans three connected domains, each driving a distinct part of our growth engine. For the daily<em> Discovery and Cooking Experience</em>, our goal is habit formation. We are building a large, top-of-funnel audience by ensuring the HelloFresh app supports users through every step of getting a weeknight dinner on the table, regardless of whether they're ordering our meal kits. In parallel, our <em>Loyalty</em> and <em>Referral</em> domains are focused on direct, immediate commercial impact. A modern loyalty program deepens our relationship with subscribers to directly increase retention and lifetime value, while viral mechanics turn our most enthusiastic users into our most efficient acquisition channel.</p> <p>You will own the vision and multi-year strategy across these domains, but your mandate is also to set a new standard for how we build AI-enabled products and how our teams operate. The job is as much about growing the PMs around you and raising the bar of the practice as it is about the strategy itself.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap across the tribe's full surface area: the daily discovery and cooking experience, loyalty, referrals, and other viral mechanics that drive organic growth.</li> <li>Lead, coach, and grow a team of ~4 Directors and Associate Directors and their respective squads (including Principal PMs), meeting each where they are and raising the standard of product thinking, experimentation, and execution across the tribe.</li> <li>Manage a hybrid operating environment: you will guide traditional squads delivering core product value, while simultaneously directing a specialized "startup" squad mandated to break existing processes, pioneer AI-enabled workflows, and act as a rapid-iteration incubator.</li> <li>Set the prioritization framework that balances the milestones moving the business near-term against the bets that pay off over a longer horizon</li> <li>Own the tribe's key results across a diverse funnel: daily active users and habit formation (top-of-funnel discovery), increased LTV and retention (loyalty), and direct conversions (referral-driven acquisition). You will build the metric framework that connects these varied customer behaviors to concrete commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Partner with the tribe's engineering and design leadership as a true peer, jointly owning what gets built and how the teams deliver</li> <li>Work hand-in-hand with marketing and CRM on program communications, reward economics, and commercial strategy, and own external vendor relationships where they exist — evaluating partnerships continuously and deciding where we build versus buy</li> <li>Act as the strategic sparring partner for senior and C-level leadership, communicating direction, defending tradeoffs, and owning the results — these products get weekly executive attention</li> <li>Set the tone on how the tribe works: fast, iterative, experiment-first. We ship a small version in a week and learn, rather than spending a quarter on a plan before anything is real</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A track record of building B2C products at scale and the teams that build them — you've managed and developed product managers</li> <li>Experience leading a scaled organization of product managers and the cross-functional teams around them</li> <li>Experience in food, or in another category people feel a genuine personal connection to — the kind of product people choose because they love it, not because they have to</li> <li>Customer-obsessed product taste and judgment: you start from customer behavior rather than leading with technology alone, forming a clear point of view and making confident calls without waiting for perfect data.</li> <li>A bias toward iterative delivery, quick decisions, and short timelines</li> <li>Executive presence: you're comfortable presenting to C-level stakeholders, holding your own with tough senior leadership, defending strategic tradeoffs, and operating at that level of visibility</li> <li>Experience working with marketing and CRM counterparts as close collaborators</li> <li>Fluency in modern AI capabilities: you know how to leverage AI to accelerate your team's workflow, and you can identify high-leverage opportunities to integrate AI into the customer experience. We are looking for a leader to set the benchmark for the rest of the company.</li> <li>Experience with loyalty, rewards, referrals, or engagement programs is a strong plus, but not a requirement</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We Offer</strong></h2> <p>Compensation &amp; Financial Wellbeing</p> <ul> <li>You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.</li> <li>Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.</li> <li>Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.</li> </ul> <p>Health &amp; Wellbeing</p> <ul> <li>Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.</li> <li>Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.</li> </ul> <p>Flexibility &amp; Work-Life</p> <ul> <li>Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.</li> <li>Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.</li> <li>Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.</li> </ul> <p>Career &amp; Development</p> <ul> <li>Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.</li> </ul> <p>Culture &amp; Environment</p> <ul> <li>Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.</li> <li>We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
description: <p>You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.</p> <h3><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h3> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.</p> <p>As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.</li> <li>Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.</li> <li>Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.</li> <li>Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on.&nbsp;</li> <li>Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.</li> <li>Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.</li> <li>Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.</li> <li>Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.</li> <li>The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.</li> <li>Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.</li> <li>A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.</li> <li>An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.</li> <li>A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.</li> <li>The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.</li> <li>Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.</li> <li>A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.</li> <li>Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.</li> <li>As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>JOB DESCRIPTION</strong></p> <p><strong>Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax</strong></p> <ul> <li>Location: Mon remotely, Tue-Fri in-office (London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, or Madrid)</li> <li>Reporting to: VP, Tax</li> <li>Reports: no formal direct reports, with broad influence on the global tax organization</li> </ul> <p>At Axon, we are on a mission to Protect Life. We build and deploy technology across public safety and justice, and we hold ourselves to high standards in how we operate — including in how we manage our obligations as a global business.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>Axon is seeking a Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax to lead the company's international VAT and indirect tax function, encompassing all non-US VAT and indirect taxes. The role carries overall responsibility for the quality and accuracy of all indirect tax compliance output, as well as providing advisory support to internal teams on indirect tax matters arising from contracts, new market entry, entity set-up, and tax law changes.</p> <p>The successful candidate will be commercially minded, technically strong across European and global VAT systems, experienced in indirect tax compliance, and confident advising Finance, Legal, and Commercial colleagues without requiring escalation. The role supervises three indirect tax team members, reporting directly to the Vice President, Tax.&nbsp; Experience in a hardware and software business with a complex supply chain is highly desired.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Internal Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for non-US indirect tax queries across Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams.</li> <li>Liaise with sales teams and other partners to understand upstream sales processes that impact indirect tax operationalization and compliance matters.</li> <li>Advise on the VAT treatment of customer contracts, pricing structures, and invoicing arrangements, working directly with Sales and Legal as required.</li> <li>Provide VAT guidance on new product lines and SKU launches, including taxability assessments and sales tax code assignments in D365.</li> <li>Represent the indirect tax function in e-invoicing projects and regulatory change programmes.</li> <li>Support the business through tax authority audits, enquiries, and disputes.</li> <li>Monitor legislative developments across relevant jurisdictions and communicate implications to the business.</li> <li>Advise and inform management on growing areas of focus in non-US indirect compliance and audits, technology trends and solutions, and process improvements.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review and approve all indirect tax compliance deliverables — VAT returns, Intrastat, OSS, and ESL — across all in-scope jurisdictions, with full accountability for accuracy and submission deadlines.</li> <li>Oversee indirect tax accounting, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and BlackLine certification.</li> <li>Maintain the compliance calendar and validate data quality across all submissions.</li> <li>Monitor VAT payments and refunds; liaise with local tax authorities where required.</li> <li>Provide guidance to Finance and operational teams on compliance requirements as they arise.</li> </ul> <p><strong>New Entity Set-Up</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the indirect tax workstream for all new entity formations, covering VAT registration, system readiness, and the preparation of compliant workpaper frameworks prior to first filing.</li> <li>Review and approve invoice templates for new entities before they commence trading.</li> <li>Ensure SOX and internal control obligations are met across all indirect tax processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process and Systems</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and implement improvements to VAT filing workflows, including the use of AI, macros, Alteryx, and D365 configuration.</li> <li>Participate in or lead system testing for indirect tax-related ERP and reporting changes.</li> <li>Maintain commodity code tax tables and item sales tax code frameworks in D365.</li> <li>Ensure processes are documented and structured to support an expanding compliance footprint.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 10 years' experience in VAT or indirect tax, gained in-house at a multinational or in a professional services environment.</li> <li>Detailed working knowledge of VAT across multiple European jurisdictions, including Intrastat, OSS, and ESL reporting obligations.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience reviewing and approving compliance deliverables prepared by others, with personal accountability for quality and timeliness.</li> <li>Experience advising on the indirect tax treatment of commercial contracts, pricing arrangements, and customer invoicing.</li> <li>Experience managing the indirect tax aspects of new entity set-ups, including VAT registration and process build-out.</li> <li>Familiarity with Microsoft D365 or a comparable ERP; working knowledge of BlackLine, Sigma, and Alteryx is advantageous.</li> <li>Understanding of SOX internal control requirements in a tax context.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly on technical VAT matters to non-specialist colleagues across Legal, Finance, and Commercial functions.</li> <li>Experience managing and leading a team.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>JOB DESCRIPTION</strong></p> <p><strong>Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax</strong></p> <ul> <li>Location: Mon remotely, Tue-Fri in-office (London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, or Madrid)</li> <li>Reporting to: VP, Tax</li> <li>Reports: no formal direct reports, with broad influence on the global tax organization</li> </ul> <p>At Axon, we are on a mission to Protect Life. We build and deploy technology across public safety and justice, and we hold ourselves to high standards in how we operate — including in how we manage our obligations as a global business.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>Axon is seeking a Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax to lead the company's international VAT and indirect tax function, encompassing all non-US VAT and indirect taxes. The role carries overall responsibility for the quality and accuracy of all indirect tax compliance output, as well as providing advisory support to internal teams on indirect tax matters arising from contracts, new market entry, entity set-up, and tax law changes.</p> <p>The successful candidate will be commercially minded, technically strong across European and global VAT systems, experienced in indirect tax compliance, and confident advising Finance, Legal, and Commercial colleagues without requiring escalation. The role supervises three indirect tax team members, reporting directly to the Vice President, Tax.&nbsp; Experience in a hardware and software business with a complex supply chain is highly desired.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Internal Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for non-US indirect tax queries across Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams.</li> <li>Liaise with sales teams and other partners to understand upstream sales processes that impact indirect tax operationalization and compliance matters.</li> <li>Advise on the VAT treatment of customer contracts, pricing structures, and invoicing arrangements, working directly with Sales and Legal as required.</li> <li>Provide VAT guidance on new product lines and SKU launches, including taxability assessments and sales tax code assignments in D365.</li> <li>Represent the indirect tax function in e-invoicing projects and regulatory change programmes.</li> <li>Support the business through tax authority audits, enquiries, and disputes.</li> <li>Monitor legislative developments across relevant jurisdictions and communicate implications to the business.</li> <li>Advise and inform management on growing areas of focus in non-US indirect compliance and audits, technology trends and solutions, and process improvements.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review and approve all indirect tax compliance deliverables — VAT returns, Intrastat, OSS, and ESL — across all in-scope jurisdictions, with full accountability for accuracy and submission deadlines.</li> <li>Oversee indirect tax accounting, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and BlackLine certification.</li> <li>Maintain the compliance calendar and validate data quality across all submissions.</li> <li>Monitor VAT payments and refunds; liaise with local tax authorities where required.</li> <li>Provide guidance to Finance and operational teams on compliance requirements as they arise.</li> </ul> <p><strong>New Entity Set-Up</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the indirect tax workstream for all new entity formations, covering VAT registration, system readiness, and the preparation of compliant workpaper frameworks prior to first filing.</li> <li>Review and approve invoice templates for new entities before they commence trading.</li> <li>Ensure SOX and internal control obligations are met across all indirect tax processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process and Systems</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and implement improvements to VAT filing workflows, including the use of AI, macros, Alteryx, and D365 configuration.</li> <li>Participate in or lead system testing for indirect tax-related ERP and reporting changes.</li> <li>Maintain commodity code tax tables and item sales tax code frameworks in D365.</li> <li>Ensure processes are documented and structured to support an expanding compliance footprint.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 10 years' experience in VAT or indirect tax, gained in-house at a multinational or in a professional services environment.</li> <li>Detailed working knowledge of VAT across multiple European jurisdictions, including Intrastat, OSS, and ESL reporting obligations.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience reviewing and approving compliance deliverables prepared by others, with personal accountability for quality and timeliness.</li> <li>Experience advising on the indirect tax treatment of commercial contracts, pricing arrangements, and customer invoicing.</li> <li>Experience managing the indirect tax aspects of new entity set-ups, including VAT registration and process build-out.</li> <li>Familiarity with Microsoft D365 or a comparable ERP; working knowledge of BlackLine, Sigma, and Alteryx is advantageous.</li> <li>Understanding of SOX internal control requirements in a tax context.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly on technical VAT matters to non-specialist colleagues across Legal, Finance, and Commercial functions.</li> <li>Experience managing and leading a team.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job.
