description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads. This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.   What You'll Be Doing BAU & Platform Stability Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes. Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments. Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes. Kubernetes  Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability. Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management. Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems. Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery. Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health. Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.   What We're Looking For Must-Have Strong interpersonal and communication skills : we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible : roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments Understanding of networking fundamentals Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent) Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state A methodical, security-conscious approach Nice-to-Have Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context) Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator) Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities   The Kind of Person We're After You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool Autonomously drive outcomes : we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next   What We Offer True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution. A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.   We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you. UK Benefits & Perks 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays  Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year Private Medical and Dental Insurance  Enhanced pension contributions Cycle to Work scheme  Eye Care Vouchers  Life Assurance Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs Regular company events and activities Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception. Privacy and data protection . The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here:  https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/ Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. raw.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Remote UK Only)
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme

We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

raw.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Remote UK Only)
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema. Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible. About the role This is an existing role within our team. As a Senior Animator, you'll be a key creative force in breathing life, weight, and personality into complex three-dimensional characters and photorealistic creatures. You’ll jump straight into the heart of our storytelling, crafting everything from nuanced, emotional facial expressions to epic, high-action combat performances. If you have a passion for mastering complex anatomy and love the challenge of making mythical beasts—whether they walk, fly, or breathe fire—feel completely grounded in reality, this is the place to do it. What you’ll do Collaborate closely with your Animation Lead and Supervisor to produce premium, story-driven animation that elevates the pacing and style of the film. Animate both primary and secondary characters, ensuring every element in the frame possesses authentic motion and soul. Take ownership of your workflow, keeping production schedules transparent and hitting your deadlines consistently. Mentor and support less senior artists, sharing your craft and helping them grow their skills. An understanding of character rigs, animation pipelines, and data transfer between production tools. Clear, constructive communication and a genuinely collaborative approach to working across distributed pipeline teams. Adaptability, an open mind for direction, and a calm, reliable focus when deadlines approach. You might also have Experience working with, clean-up, or editing of motion capture data. A traditional background in sketching, life drawing, or classic 2D animation. A working knowledge of Modelling or basic scripting (Python/MEL) to streamline workflows. The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio, at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. The Role
As a Compositor at Framestore London, you're not just blending images; you're part of a creative conversation. Work closely with Compositing Leads, Compositing Supervisors, as well as, VFX Supervisors to figure out the best way to bring assigned shots to life. Your responsibilities include integrating 2D, 3D, and live-action elements to achieve high-end film visual effects standards.

Additionally, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Keeping the project on track by meeting schedules and project deadlines.

  • Maintaining open lines of communication with Production.

  • Balance the creative and technical elements of each shot, using your expertise in Nuke.


Job Requirements

  • Excellent working knowledge of and production experience with Nuke.

  • Work with multiple render-passes.

  • Excellent organisation, communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A pro-active and collaborative work ethic.

  • A strong eye for detail, composition, colour and lighting.

  • The ability to multitask, prioritise and problem-solve.

  • An understanding of colour space principles.

Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of practical lighting for photography.

  • Knowledge of the overall VFX pipeline.

  • Experience in dealing and communicating with clients.

  • Programming and coding experience and knowledge.

title: Fullstack Engineer - Subscriptions
description: The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners. Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services. As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale. What You'll Do Build end-to-end features across modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms that support Spotify's global subscription business. Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows. Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that power subscriptions, prepaid products, pricing, promotions, and the offer lifecycle. Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services. Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL. Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows. Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability. Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement. Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium. Who You Are You have experience building and delivering production software across both frontend and backend technologies. You have experience developing scalable backend services using modern Java, with Java 17+ experience being a plus. You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js. You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications. You have worked with gRPC services and Protocol Buffers, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in distributed systems. You have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization. You care about writing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software that delivers long-term value. You enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes. You have a passion for simplifying complex workflows and creating intuitive experiences for internal users. Experience with tools such as jOOQ, Flyway, Apollo GraphQL, DataLoader, Styled Components, Storybook, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar technologies will help you ramp up quickly. Experience building commerce platforms, subscription products, pricing systems, distributed systems, or large-scale platform modernization initiatives is beneficial. Where You'll Be We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location. This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zones for collaboration. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <p>At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe.</p> <p>We are seeking a Backend Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and operational clarity are paramount. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain.</p> <p>You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams.</p> <p>Some things you might be expected to do could include:</p> <ul> <li>Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code</li> <li>Implementing new microservices or systems</li> <li>Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions</li> <li>Coordinating with product and UX when needed</li> <li>Responding to customer requests and feedback</li> <li>When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation</li> <li>Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience</li> <li>You have some experience working on a SaaS platform and are familiar with common distributed systems concepts (e.g., scalability, multi-tenancy, HA).</li> <li>Have professional experience with Golang and be willing to work across both backend service and application code</li> <li>Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on</li> <li>Have some experience contributing to the delivery of projects, from initial brainstorming to shipping a product to the customer.</li> <li>You write clean, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain</li> <li>Can take on well-defined tasks, break them down, and execute iteratively to deliver working solutions and gather feedback.</li> <li>You are willing to collaborate across teams and ensure your work is aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Familiarity with Kubernetes in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and exposure to infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.).</li> <li>Experience participating in blameless incident response and contributing to post-incident reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with TypeScript/Node.js</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes control-plane patterns, operators, reconcilers, or desired-state systems</li> <li>Experience with Jsonnet/Tanka, Terraform, Flux, Argo, or similar deployment/configuration tooling</li> <li>Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems</li> <li>Experience with incident response involving configuration drift, partial failure, or cross-service state mismatch</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In United Kingdom, the compensation range for this role is GBP 72K - GBP 90K. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base
  • Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
  • Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We're a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

  • Swift Programming Language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Experience in Multithreading Programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
  • A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
  • Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
  • Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

Think you're a good fit for this job? 

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them! 

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Client Director
description: MISSION Bei STAN sind Client Directors strategische Sparringspartner – keine klassischen Account Manager. Sie führen anspruchsvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf höchstem Niveau, gestalten strategische Diskussionen, erkennen Chancen, bevor sie entstehen, und stellen sicher, dass jede Zusammenarbeit die Qualität, den Anspruch und die Denkweise widerspiegelt, für die STAN steht. Sie übernehmen die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für den Erfolg ihrer Kunden und tragen gleichzeitig aktiv zu Strategie, Wachstum und exzellenter kreativer Arbeit bei. DEINE AUFGABEN Client Leadership & Strategische Partnerschaft Werde vertrauensvoller Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden und baue Beziehungen auf, die weit über einzelne Projekte hinausgehen. Übernimm die vollständige Verantwortung für den Erfolg, die Entwicklung und das Wachstum deines Kundenportfolios und stelle sicher, dass kein Detail verloren geht und jede Zusammenarbeit außergewöhnlichen Mehrwert schafft. Erkenne Kundenbedürfnisse, geschäftliche Herausforderungen und neue Chancen, bevor sie von deinen Kunden selbst identifiziert werden. Berate CEOs, Gründer:innen, CMOs und weitere Führungskräfte souverän zu Themen wie Unternehmensstrategie, Markenentwicklung, kultureller Relevanz, Innovation, Partnerschaften und Wachstum. Führe strategische Gespräche, moderiere Workshops und begleite komplexe Stakeholder-Prozesse mit Klarheit, Souveränität und Überzeugungskraft. Strategische Beratung Entwickle strategische Narrative, Positionierungen, kulturelle Plattformen und Wachstumsstrategien mit nachhaltiger Wirkung. Übersetze komplexe unternehmerische Herausforderungen in klare strategische Empfehlungen und umsetzbare Lösungen. Erarbeite Strategien, schärfe Botschaften, optimiere Präsentationen und hinterfrage Denkansätze, um jede Arbeit auf das nächste Niveau zu heben. Arbeite eng mit den STAN Foundern sowie den Teams aus New Business, Strategy, Creative, Production, Social und AI zusammen, um strategisches Denken in außergewöhnliche Umsetzung zu übersetzen. Verbinde Ideen, Branchen und Chancen auf unerwartete Weise und schaffe dadurch strategische Wettbewerbsvorteile für unsere Kunden. Kundenerfolg & Qualität Übernimm die Gesamtverantwortung für die Kundenbeziehung – von der strategischen Ausrichtung bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Fungiere als Qualitätsinstanz für sämtliche Kundenprojekte und stelle sicher, dass jede Arbeit den kreativen Ansprüchen von STAN entspricht. Hinterfrage Ideen kontinuierlich, schärfe Ergebnisse und hebe gemeinsam mit den Teams das strategische und kreative Niveau. Sorge dafür, dass Projekte mit höchster Qualität, Konsistenz und Liebe zum Detail umgesetzt werden. Wachstum & Geschäftsentwicklung Erkenne Potenziale, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen durch neue Projekte, strategische Partnerschaften und langfristige Retainer auszubauen. Entwickle Angebote, Leistungsumfänge und strategische Empfehlungen, die sowohl für unsere Kunden als auch für STAN nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Baue vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, aus denen langfristige Partnerschaften, Folgeprojekte und Weiterempfehlungen entstehen. Beziehungsentwicklung Entwickle langfristige Partnerschaften, die auf Vertrauen, Glaubwürdigkeit und exzellentem Service basieren. Erkenne Potenziale, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltige Kooperationen aufzubauen. Werde durch proaktives Denken, Verlässlichkeit und strategische Führung zu einem geschätzten Teil der Teams unserer Kunden. Repräsentiere STAN souverän in Kundenterminen, Workshops, internationalen Präsentationen und Branchenevents. Leadership Führe interdisziplinäre Teams mit Empathie, Klarheit und hohen Qualitätsansprüchen. Inspiriere und fördere Kolleg:innen und schaffe ein Umfeld, in dem außergewöhnliche Arbeit entstehen kann. Übernimm Verantwortung statt lediglich zu koordinieren – indem du mit gutem Beispiel vorangehst und selbst aktiv zu strategischen und kreativen Ergebnissen beiträgst. DEIN PROFIL Strategische Führungspersönlichkeit Mindestens 6-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer führenden Kreativagentur, Markenberatung oder Strategieberatung. Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Führung internationaler Kunden sowie komplexer Stakeholder-Strukturen. Fundiertes Verständnis von Unternehmensstrategie, Markenentwicklung, Cultural Strategy, Innovation, Experience Design und integrierter Kommunikation. Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, strategische Empfehlungen zu entwickeln und überzeugend vor Führungskräften und Entscheidungsträgern zu präsentieren. Hands-on-Berater:in Du koordinierst nicht nur Spezialisten, sondern arbeitest selbst aktiv an den Inhalten mit. Du entwickelst Strategien, optimierst Präsentationen, moderierst Workshops, schärfst Botschaften und hinterfragst Denkansätze. Du verbindest strategische Exzellenz mit unternehmerischem Verständnis und einer außergewöhnlich hohen Umsetzungsqualität. Du erkennst Chancen frühzeitig, löst Probleme proaktiv und bringst Projekte mit Eigeninitiative voran. Beziehungsmanager:in Du baust Vertrauen auf, bevor es um Geschäft geht. Du entwickelst langfristige Partnerschaften, anstatt Projekte lediglich zu verwalten. Du verstehst es, Kunden zu inspirieren, herauszufordern und zu überzeugen, ohne tragfähige Beziehungen zu gefährden. Du überzeugst durch Souveränität, Präsenz und ein sicheres Urteilsvermögen auf Executive-Ebene. Unternehmerisches Denken Du erkennst Potenziale, Kundenbeziehungen durch strategisches Denken und vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Du fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Angeboten, Leistungsumfängen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeitsmodellen. Du verstehst, wie exzellente Kundenführung nachhaltiges Unternehmenswachstum ermöglicht. Qualitätsanspruch Du verfügst über ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Qualität und höchste Ansprüche an jedes Detail. Du hebst die Qualität jeder Arbeit und inspirierst dein Umfeld dazu, denselben Anspruch zu verfolgen. Dir sind kreative Exzellenz und messbarer geschäftlicher Erfolg gleichermaßen wichtig. Persönliche Eigenschaften Neugierig, unternehmerisch denkend und von Natur aus proaktiv. Ruhig und souverän – auch in dynamischen oder unklaren Situationen. Begeistert für Kultur, Kreativität, KI, Innovation und die Zukunft von Marken und Unternehmen. Hervorragende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (nahezu muttersprachliches Niveau) sind Voraussetzung. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse wie Deutsch, Französisch oder Arabisch sind von Vorteil. Erfahrung oder Interesse im Bereich Women's Health ist von Vorteil. Verfügbarkeit Wohnsitz in den USA, idealerweise in New York oder Los Angeles. Die Zusammenarbeit startet zunächst auf Freelance-Basis mit der Perspektive, diese langfristig in eine Festanstellung zu überführen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Admin Services - Senior Country Commercial Manager - UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h2>About the team&nbsp;</h2> <p>The Admin Services commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners.&nbsp; This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company Secretariat services.&nbsp; Most of these are sold on a subscription basis, providing consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. &nbsp; The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention.&nbsp;</p> <h2>About the role<strong>&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Country Commercial Manager to drive revenue growth from our Invoicing and Expense Management products, as well as leading on our Accountant GTM. You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function, and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand product performance, uncover opportunities, and work across multiple areas to deliver.&nbsp; This will require a relentless focus on the numbers and our members, product prioritisation, and detailed planning to ensure revenue targets are hit and customer lifetime value is always increasing.<br><br>In this role, you will be responsible for the strategy and implementation of core activities to drive activation and usage of Invoicing and Expense Management as well as unlocking growth out of Accountants. This includes close partnership with marketing teams to ensure seamless delivery of ‘always on’ campaign activity.&nbsp; This role will also own the strategy and launch approach for new product launches, ensuring that all channels and member touch points are considered.&nbsp; This includes end-to-end journeys and transaction channels.&nbsp; You’ll need to partner effectively with multiple stakeholders to make this happen – excellent organisation and communication skills essential.</p> <p><strong>Some of the things you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Revenue Ownership &amp; Forecasting</strong>: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine financial projections for Invoicing, Expense Management and Accountants, ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Analytics-Driven Insight: </strong>with the support of the BI team you will analyse member behaviour, segment audiences, and measure subscription cohort&nbsp; performance. You will then translate this data into clear recommendations that shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications.</li> <li><strong>Product Development: </strong>Leveraging the commercial and analytics insights, you will partner with the Product teams to address areas of opportunity.&nbsp; This will include shaping product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting&nbsp; successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.</li> <li><strong>Launch Strategy</strong>: &nbsp; You’ll support new feature launches across channels, partnering with excellent sales, and operations teams to deliver best-in-class experiments.&nbsp; You’ll facilitate brainstorm sessions / workshops to surface creative ideas and implementation plans.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:&nbsp; </strong>As you’ll be working in a highly collaborative way, it will be key to communicate regularly with a wide range of stakeholders.&nbsp; This will include Tide’s Senior Leadership Team as well as the C-Suite.</li> <li><strong>Commercial &amp; Competitor Intelligence:</strong> Lead ongoing commercial research and competitive analysis to monitor trends, and benchmark to translate it into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.</li> <li><strong>Member Obsession:</strong> You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong commercial acumen</strong>:&nbsp; Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve.&nbsp; Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals.</li> <li><strong>5+ years’ experience leading ‘always on’ activity to drive commercial performance.&nbsp; </strong>&nbsp;This will ideally be with specific experience in Accounting, Invoicing or Expense Management products, ideally in a fintech environment – key is demonstrated ability to plan and deliver consistent activity that drives commercial impact.</li> <li><strong>Strong analytical mindset</strong>: Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans.</li> <li><strong>Proven GTM track record</strong> – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns&nbsp; (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points)</li> <li><strong>Exceptional project management skills</strong>, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li><strong>Creative collaborator: </strong>Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.</li> <li><strong>Self-starter attitude</strong>: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>What you’ll get in return</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>Professional L&amp;D budget per year</li> <li>Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide&nbsp;</li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>24 hours paid volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible work from home or at the office arrangements</li> <li>Monthly team socials (we’ve had themed bingo, online cocktail making sessions, wellbeing challenges and themed virtual pub quizzes)</li> <li>Sabbatical leave&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. title: Senior Sales Development Representative
description: About Achievers Achievers offers more than just a thank you program. Our employee recognition and rewards software inspires employees to recognize everyone, every day, everywhere. With 4.3 million global users, we empower employees across 190 countries. Visit us at achievers.com to learn more and check out our platform in action. Join our team of A-players who bring passion to our purpose and believe that meaningful change creates extraordinary outcomes — together, we’ll inspire recognition everywhere and achieve results that matter.  Our commitment to you: At Achievers, we hire you for you because we value the unique perspective and individuality that each person brings to our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where you belong, and your contributions are celebrated. Together, we achieve more by combining our unique strengths, fostering collaboration, and inspiring each other to reach new heights.  The opportunity: As a Senior Sales Development Representative (Sr. SDR), you will play a critical role in driving pipeline generation and revenue growth across the EMEA region. Building upon core sales development expertise, you will own strategic prospecting initiatives, develop targeted account penetration strategies, and partner closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to create qualified opportunities within enterprise and mid-market organisations.   You will also serve as a role model and mentor to newer SDRs, sharing best practices and helping elevate overall team performance. How you will shape sales development at Achievers: Generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting across assigned EMEA territories. Conduct research and account mapping to identify key decision-makers, influencers, and buying committees within target organisations. Build relationships with multiple stakeholders across prospective accounts to increase account penetration and create new business opportunities. Partner closely with Account Executives to develop account strategies, progress opportunities, and drive pipeline growth. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe.
