description: <p><strong>Some key info for you about Liberis:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>🌱 We were founded in 2007</p> <p>💰 We have provided over $3bn of funding to small businesses so far</p> <p>🚀 We have been named in<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>CNBC &amp; Statista Top 150 UK Fintechs for 2025</strong></p> <p>🌍 We're a global team, with a dynamic presence in<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>6</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>key locations around the world</p> <p>🧠 We're a thriving community of over<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>290</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>innovative minds</p> <p>👩🏾 🤝 👨🏼 We're a vibrant melting pot, celebrating over<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>27</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>nationalities in our team</p> <p>🏢 Our team brings experience from over<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>740</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>previous companies, from startups to global giants</p> <p>🎯 We have just been named as one of<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>FinTech’s Finest 50</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>by Welcome to the Jungle</p> <p>💪 We’re proud to be an accredited<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>Real Living Wage</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>employer, ensuring everyone is paid fairly for the great work they do!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Product &amp; Engineering Team:</strong></p> <p>Liberis is building the embedded finance platform that lets partners around the world offer innovative funding products to their small business customers. We're a growth-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data &amp; Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Engineering is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The role:</strong></p> <p>The Cloud Platform team builds and operates the shared infrastructure and developer tooling that every engineering team at Liberis depends on. We’re now running all new services in GCP and are actively migrating onto GCP from our legacy Azure platform. As we scale our use of AI, we're looking to add a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer with an emphasis on AI Enablement to help build and run the shared infrastructure our product teams depend on and to expand how we use AI across the platform.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our services are built in .NET, Node.js, and Python, primarily on both GCP and Azure. You'll work across the platform stack, and you'll be the person nudging us to make AI a practical, everyday part of how we build and operate. You'll spot where AI can make the platform and the teams on it faster, from AI-assisted developer tooling to agents that take real work off people's plates, and you'll help turn those ideas into things people use, with the guardrails and cost controls that make them safe to run.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll get to do in the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the cloud infrastructure and tooling our product teams rely on, across compute, networking, CI/CD, and deployment on Kubernetes or Cloud Run.</li> <li>Champion AI agent adoption across the platform: spot where agents can take on real work, prototype it, and turn the promising work into supported, reusable capabilities teams can build on.</li> <li>Build the foundations for AI agents: integrations with Claude, the tools and services agents call, and the orchestration that ties them together.</li> <li>Wire observability, guardrails, and cost controls into the AI agents and tooling we run, so they stay safe and predictable in production.</li> <li>Work hands-on with the AI tooling and agent frameworks we build on — Claude in particular, which we use extensively — and bring what you learn back to the wider team.</li> <li>Manage infrastructure with Terraform, keeping environments consistent, auditable, and reproducible.</li> <li>Contribute to our Azure-to-GCP migration thinking, especially what it means for our AI tooling and agents.</li> <li>Partner with product engineers to lower the barrier to using AI, writing the docs, templates, and examples that drive adoption.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we think you'll need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Genuine enthusiasm for AI agents and a desire to help us adopt them well. You don't need a machine-learning or model-training background — this is about building with tools like Claude, not training or serving models — but you should be keen to learn and to lead by doing.</li> <li>Strong GCP experience (Azure experience is nice to have)</li> <li>Comfortable with containerisation (Docker) and deployment on Kubernetes or Cloud Run.</li> <li>Infrastructure-as-code with Terraform.</li> <li>Proficient in at least one of .NET (C#), Node.js, or Python.</li> <li>Observability experience with Datadog or cloud-native logging and monitoring (GCP Cloud Operations or Azure Monitor).</li> <li>A track record of driving adoption — building things engineers use, writing docs that get read.</li> <li>Comfortable leading technical decisions, collaborating across teams, and mentoring other engineers.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. You can have a look through our Engineering Career Framework via&nbsp;<a href="https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/liberis/jobs/263e2181723d80a29d3ece5201242561">this link&nbsp;</a></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Our hybrid approach</strong><br>Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.<br><br>#LI-FC1</div> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We're a growth-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data &amp; Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! We're also supporting the AI/ML platform team with reliable, low-latency feature pipelines and model serving infrastructure.</p> <p>We're collaborative, pragmatic, and we value moving fast by fixing the right problems—not over-engineering, but building to last!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The team is made up of three functions:</strong></p> <p><strong>Data Platform Engineering:</strong> Building and scaling ELT pipelines, managing data infrastructure on GCP, and creating the foundation for analytics and ML feature stores. You'll be part of a small, high-performing team of platform engineers focused on reliability, scale, and developer velocity.</p> <p><strong>Analytics Engineering:</strong> Transform raw data into trusted models using DBT and SQL, powering self-serve analytics and business intelligence for stakeholders across the company.</p> <p><strong>Data &amp; Business Intelligence</strong>: Build dashboards, partner-facing reports, and insights that drive business decisions and revenue outcomes.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll get to do in the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain resilient data pipelines that ingest data from Azure SQL, SaaS platforms, and event streams into BigQuery.</li> <li>Write Python code using DLT to define declarative, testable, version-controlled pipelines - no low-code tools, real engineering.</li> <li>Build and operate ML feature pipelines - low-latency, real-time data streams that feed ML models with accurate, fresh features.</li> <li>Own the operational health of systems you build - monitoring, alerting, error handling, and incident response. When the data pipeline goes down, merchant credit decisions and ML model predictions suffer.</li> <li>Collaborate with analytics engineers to understand data needs, validate schema design, and establish data quality standards that both analytics and ML rely on.</li> <li>Partner with the AI/ML platform team to design feature stores, streaming feature infrastructure, and model serving pipelines that power Liberis' decisioning engine.</li> <li>Identify and execute optimisation work - improving performance, reliability, and developer velocity without rearchitecting stable systems.</li> <li>Mentor junior engineers, helping them grow as engineers and supporting their career development.</li> <li>Participate in technical decisions about platform direction - infrastructure choices, tooling, architecture trade-offs.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with product teams, analytics engineers, BI specialists, and the ML platform team to shape data requirements and platform capabilities.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we think you'll need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 4-5 years in data engineering roles (building and operating data pipelines at scale).</li> <li>Hands-on experience building Modern Data Stack architectures - you understand the layers: ingestion, warehouse, transformation, orchestration, reverse ETL. You've worked with tools like DLT/Fivetran/Airbyte (ingestion), BigQuery/Snowflake/Redshift (warehouse), DBT (transformation), Airflow/similar (orchestration).</li> <li>Strong Python programming - you write clean, testable, maintainable code with solid error handling and logging.</li> <li>Fluent SQL - you can write complex queries, understand execution plans, and optimize for performance and cost.</li> <li>Experience with cloud data platforms - you've built data warehouses in BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, or similar; you understand distributed processing, partitioning, cost optimization, and data governance.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi) or equivalent - you version control infrastructure and deploy it via CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Experience working in fast-moving environments where requirements evolve and you adapt quickly without losing sight of reliability.</li> <li>Understanding of DevOps principles - you think in terms of observability, resilience, incident response, and operational excellence. You can set up monitoring and alerting that actually matters.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Bonus points if you have:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with DLT or similar declarative ELT frameworks; experience with Google Cloud Platform ecosystem (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Dataflow); experience with Kafka, Pub/Sub, or event streaming platforms; experience scaling data systems from 0 to 100M+ events/day; experience implementing data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, dbt tests, custom monitoring); background in fintech or high-stakes data reliability environments where data quality directly impacts revenue.</li> <li>Experience working with distributed, asynchronous teams across timezones; experience in India tech ecosystem or building in resource-constrained environments; experience migrating from legacy data infrastructure (Azure ADF, traditional ETL) to modern cloud-native stacks.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. title: Senior Grab Crane Operative, Smugglers Way MRF
description: Step into a vital position at our Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) in Smugglers Way, Wandsworth. This is a fast‑paced, hands‑on operational role at the heart of London’s recycling system. Every day, you’ll be helping turn thousands of tonnes of commingled recyclables into high‑quality materials ready for reprocessing — ensuring that the city’s waste is handled safely, efficiently, and sustainably. As a Senior Grab Crane Operative, you’ll take ownership of managing and maintaining bunker levels, coordinating material arriving by dustcart for processing in the MRF. You’ll be the go‑to person for overseeing junior and agency operatives, giving direction, offering guidance, and ensuring everyone works to the highest safety and operational standards. You’ll also play a key role in liaising with TAC Control, Shift Supervisors and sampling teams to keep material quality high and operations flowing smoothly. Effective communication and calm decision‑making will be essential, especially in a busy environment where no two days look the same. This role also brings opportunities to contribute to wider operational planning — from resource allocation and maintenance coordination to supporting the smooth running of the site. You’ll be central to maintaining a safe, organised and high‑performing facility that helps keep London’s recycling moving. Please note: This role is Monday to Friday, 14:00 to 22:00. We’re looking for someone with experience in a similar environment — preferably within recycling, MRF operations or an engineering‑based setting. You should be comfortable making decisions in a high‑pressure operational setting, with a strong understanding of safe working practices and statutory requirements. Being a team player is essential. You’ll be guiding junior operatives, supporting colleagues across the facility, and ensuring that daily check sheets, paperwork and handovers are completed clearly and on time. Strong communication skills will help you keep everything running smoothly. You’ll need the willingness to work flexibly, including additional hours or alternative shifts as required. A practical mindset, hands‑on attitude and readiness to assist with wider site tasks — including cleaning and maintenance duties — will make you a great fit. If you’re driven, reliable and motivated by making a difference in essential environmental operations, you’ll thrive in this role and become a valued part of an experienced and dedicated team. raw.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole. 

  • Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond. 

  • Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements. 

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR. 

  • Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests. 

  • Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers. 

  • Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level. 

  • Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation. 

  • Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively. 

  • Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace. 


Who you are

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments. 

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions. 

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems. 

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level. 

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies. 

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components. 

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data. 

  • Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre. 

  • Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter. 


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) 

What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

Senior Tech Talent Acquisition Partner

At SumUp, we build simple, affordable financial tools that empower over 4 million small businesses worldwide to get paid, manage their money, and thrive. We are a global team of 3,000+ people across 20+ offices and 90+ nationalities, all dedicated to supporting merchants with excellent products.

As a Talent Acquisition team, we don't just fill seats. We care deeply about hiring excellence and finding people who truly elevate our teams. For us, recruitment is a team sport - we win together, constantly looking at how we can improve and bounce ideas off each other, and always step in to help whenever someone gets stuck or hits a wall.

Our Consumer Tribe - building the SumUp Pay App - is scaling fast and we're looking for a Senior Tech TA Partner to help the team navigate London's hyper-competitive market, where top engineers are in high demand.Your superpower will be understanding how to position SumUp's massive scale and impact to passive talent. Operating as a true talent advisor, you will own hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, and Design (EP&D) for the Consumer portfolio, scaling the technical teams responsible for turning SumUp into a leading financial services platform.

Take a look at our London office 

What you'll do

  • Lead the full-cycle hiring journey for complex roles across Engineering, Product, Design, and Data for the Consumer tribe, maintaining a consistently high talent bar as we scale.
  • Build trusted, embedded relationships with Consumer leadership. You'll serve as a proactive advisor rather than a reactive coordinator - running regular hiring cadences, maintaining pipeline visibility, and providing market-led recommendations on role prioritization.
  • Excel at identifying, engaging, and closing high-caliber passive tech talent in the London market, knowing how to articulate our technical challenges and unique value proposition effectively.
  • Track and analyze funnel health metrics across your portfolio to surface blockers, challenge hiring assumptions, optimize sourcing efforts, and provide stakeholders with clear, honest pipeline updates.
  • Create an inclusive hiring process that guarantees an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring teams alike, ensuring we stand out in a crowded market.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have a proven track record of managing full-cycle talent acquisition for complex Engineering, Product, Data, and Design roles within fast-moving tech or fintech environments.
  • You possess a deep understanding of the London and broader UK tech landscape, with a knack for mapping talent pools and knowing what it takes to attract and win over high-demand, engineering talent.
  • You operate as a trusted business partner rather than just executing briefs - confidently managing multi-stakeholder portfolios, advising hiring managers on market realities, and expertly guiding interview calibration and debriefs.
  • You have a data-first mindset, using funnel analytics and recruiting metrics to identify what's working, track pipeline efficiency, and clearly influence stakeholder decisions.
  • You have a genuine care for candidate experience, bringing empathy and transparency to every stage of the hiring journey.

Please note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. You must have the right to work in the UK to be considered.

 

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central Covent Garden location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

description: The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies. Overview We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us. What You'll Do Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform. Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models. Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products. An Ideal Candidate Should Have BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field. 5+ years of industry experience in software development. Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP) Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. What we offer A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product. An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle. A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work. An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry. Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture. Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use. Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more. Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio. Think you're a good fit for this job?  Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn. Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?  Refer them!  Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.  Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. title: Staff/Senior AI Engineer, AI for Code
description: <p>At JetBrains, we build developer tools used by millions of engineers. The AI for Code team works on the next generation of coding agents and agentic workflows: systems that can understand codebases, plan and execute multi-step tasks, collaborate with developers, and ship reliable results inside real development environments.</p> <p>We are looking for a Staff/Senior AI Engineer to join the team and support these efforts. This role is for someone who can take our internal coding models, such as Mellum2, as well as open-weight models, and turn them into production-ready coding agents for our users. You’ll work on model training and fine-tuning, context engineering, tool use, evaluation, feedback loops, and product integration. This is not research in isolation – you’ll build systems that are used by tens of thousands of developers.</p> <h2>What you’ll do:</h2> <ul> <li>Build production-ready coding agents and agentic workflows for real developer tasks inside JetBrains products.</li> <li>Turn promising model capabilities into dependable product behavior through prompt design, context construction, fine-tuning, instruction-tuning, or other post-training techniques where appropriate.</li> <li>Design and improve the agent loop itself, including tool use, execution strategy, safeguards, and task completion quality.</li> <li>Create evaluation suites and quality infrastructure for agent behavior, including online and offline evaluations, regression checks, failure analysis, and release criteria.</li> <li>Build feedback loops from real usage, using logs, user signals, and edge cases to improve data, evaluations, and agent behavior.</li> <li>Work with both hosted frontier APIs and self-hosted or open-weight models, making pragmatic decisions about where each model belongs based on capability, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, ML engineers, and researchers to ship features end to end.</li> <li>Help define the technical direction for future work, especially in ambiguous areas where we need strong judgment rather than a prewritten playbook.</li> </ul> <h2>What we’re looking for:</h2> <ul> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping complex systems to production.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building LLM-powered products, coding agents, or other AI systems.</li> <li>Experience improving model behavior through systematic iteration, whether via prompting, context engineering, fine-tuning, preference optimization, or broader post-training methods.</li> <li>Practical experience with evaluation and benchmarking for LLM systems, including defining task-grounded success metrics and catching regressions.</li> <li>Experience working from noisy real-world signals rather than only from clean benchmark datasets.</li> <li>Good judgment about trade-offs between model quality, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost.</li> <li>Confidence working with ambiguity and taking ownership of a direction over multiple iterations.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to align engineering and product decisions.</li> </ul> <h2>What success looks like in the first year:</h2> <ul> <li>You ship one or more agent capabilities that users can rely on for meaningful work, not just demos.</li> <li>You establish better evaluation coverage and clearer release criteria for agent behavior.</li> <li>You help the team build a repeatable loop from idea to shipped capability: prototype, evaluate, learn from usage, improve, and scale.</li> </ul> <h2>Why join us?</h2> <p>You’ll help define what practical, trustworthy AI for software development looks like title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
description: <p>You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.</p> <h3><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h3> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.</p> <p>As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.</li> <li>Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.</li> <li>A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h3> <ul> setups.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What success looks like</strong></h3> <p>Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem.
